column7: taker_fee_pct: Taker 0.04% is the standard rate for the USDT-M BTCUSDT perpetual. MEXC sets futures fees per contract, and this value matches the official fee page (Futures tab, checked 2026-10-14), the public contract API (BTC_USDT, checked 2026-10-08) and the fee charged on a real trade (checked 2026-08-24). Other contracts can differ (for example ETHUSDT taker 0.02%), so a table that lists 0.02% for MEXC may be quoting a different contract. | maker_fee_pct: MEXC may apply a different futures maker fee in some regions (such as parts of Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Latin America). Go by the rate shown on your trading screen.
